components.name: Primary Action Pill Button
components.description: One-tap primary action pill for logging +1 Japa Round (Spacebar shortcut) or saving inline forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background-color: var(--accent, #1b6e66); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--accent-hover, #155750); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1b6e66); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Simplified Daily Japa Counter Card
components.description: Clean raised card holding the 36px Japa round counter, -1 / +1 / +4 / 16 Done buttons, and 12px progress track.
components.html: 12 of 16 rounds (1,296 mantras)
components.css: .ds-japa-card { background-color: var(--raised, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2ddd2); border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-japa-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-japa-num { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text, #1c201e); } .ds-japa-sub { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted, #575652); } .ds-japa-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-pri { height: 38px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: var(--accent, #1b6e66); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-sec { height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #cfc9bc); background: var(--raised, #fff); color: var(--text, #1c201e); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-prog-track { width: 100%; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, #f3efe6); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2ddd2); overflow: hidden; } .ds-prog-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #1b6e66); }

components.name: Vaishnava Calendar Day Cell
components.description: Interactive monthly calendar cell displaying date, Tithi, Sadhana round dot, and Ekadashi / festival tag.
components.css: .ds-cal-cell { width: 160px; min-height: 76px; background-color: var(--pill-warning-bg, #fff3e0); border: 1px solid var(--warning, #8c420e); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-cal-cell:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-cal-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-cal-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #1c201e); } .ds-cal-dot { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pill-positive-bg, #dcfae5); color: var(--pill-positive-ink, #04250e); } .ds-cal-tithi { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted, #575652); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-cal-fest { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--pill-warning-ink, #7c3808); margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: One-Click OAuth Sync Button
components.description: Zero-config Google / GitHub cloud sync button replacing manual REST URL and API-key fields.
components.css: .ds-oauth-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #1b6e66); background-color: var(--accent-soft, #d7ebe8); color: var(--accent-soft-ink, #123e39); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-oauth-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

narrative.overview: Sadhana Valli is an ADHD-friendly daily devotional workspace modeled after a Vaishnava Panchanga almanac resting inside a sandalwood desk tray by day and a quiet pre-dawn Brahma-muhurta study by night. Rather than overwhelming the practitioner with a 16-box time-band matrix, Granthi sub-grids, or manual API-key forms, the interface pairs a single 4-button Japa progress stepper (-1, +1 Round, +4 Rounds, 16 Done) with a Shastra reading log, a live Sravanam YouTube lecture shelf, an interactive 30-day ISKCON Vaishnava Calendar, and one-click Google/GitHub cloud sync.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-Mode Tonal L-Frame Shell: A 224px left navigation rail and 48px top bar cradle an inset workspace sheet (16px radius) with one-click switching between Sandalwood Light Mode and true-neutral Brahma-Muhurta Dark Mode.

Ultra-Simple Japa Stepper: A single raised card with a 36px regular-weight counter, a 12px pill progress bar, -1 / +1 Round / +4 Rounds / 16 Done buttons, and a themed Chanted before 07:00 AM checkbox.

Interactive ISKCON Vaishnava Calendar Engine: A 6-column monthly grid displaying Tithi, Paksha, Masa, marigold Ekadashi fast cards, city-adjusted Parana fast-break windows across 6 ISKCON temple hubs, and .ics calendar import.
Zero-Config One-Click OAuth Sync: Google and GitHub sign-in buttons that sync logs automatically without exposing database URLs or API keys.

rules.name: The Mercy Over Gamification Rule
rules.body: Never use --negative (#a12016 / #e5566f) for incomplete Japa rounds or unlogged calendar days; unfinished practice stays in calm neutral stone or warm marigold.

rules.name: The True-Neutral Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark Mode ([data-theme='dark']) uses low-chroma obsidian-charcoal grounds (#0c0d0c, #141615, #1b1e1c) with color-scheme: dark, avoiding saturated navy or glowing neon borders.

rules.name: The Single Serif Voice Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif appears only on the h1 greeting; all counters, titles, and calendar cells use Instrument Sans.

rules.name: The Regular-Weight KPI Rule
rules.body: Large numerical counters (36px Japa readout and 32px KPI figures) stay at regular weight (400) with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Zero-Drop-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never apply box-shadow to cards, buttons, or calendar cells; separate surfaces by tonal step and 1px solid borders.

dos: Do support both Light Mode and Dark Mode ([data-theme='dark']) with color-scheme and accent-color: var(--accent) so native controls match the theme.
Do keep Japa logging to a single-card stepper and progress bar reachable via Space or one tap.
Do display full city names (e.g., New York, Los Angeles, Sri Mayapur) in Parana fast-break windows.
donts: Don't reintroduce the 16-box time-band or Granthi matrix.
Don't require users to paste database REST URLs or API keys; keep Cloud Sync to one-click OAuth and JSON backup.
Don't use red error styling for incomplete Sadhana days.
